subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: why did you not go to school yesterday said the mother i was ill mum the girl replied how are you today the mother asked again well said the girl Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "Why did you not go to school yesterday, said the mother, "I was ill, mum," the girl replied. "How are you today?" the mother asked again. "Well," said the girl. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 209
